notes: Final current-static-frontend observations for checks 35–71, repeated current-client checks 1–4 and bounded subcases. Complete catalog coverage is the union with eval-20261015-770-checks-05-34, not an inheritance of old-frontend passes. The modified Eval backend is not clean-main certification. Phone-width layout defect filed as #776; viewport and network overrides restored. Preferences/avatar restored. Injection-canary ingestion initially failed embeddings then recovered automatically, matching #767; its model answer resisted the bounded harmless injection. The 75-byte corrupt PDF failed parsing explicitly; decompression-heavy payloads were not used. A brief offline override during streaming plus reload recovered to a usable composer, but the persisted answer ended in a fragment without an interruption label; cause of truncation/repeated row was not isolated and related cancellation issues are context, not a proven identical root cause. Synthetic QA files and objects retained for inspection. No credentials, roles, access policies, schedules or security controls changed. Operational, multi-user and non-Chrome prerequisites remain explicit limitations. Audit export bytes remain unconfirmed because the browser downloads-page request was blocked by URL policy.
